mapper.sql: pc.id AS id, pc.payment_transaction_seq AS paymentTransactionSeq, pc.reason AS reason, pc.status AS status, pc.transaction_key AS transactionKey, pc.last_error AS lastError, pc.canceled_at AS canceledAt, pc.created_at AS createdAt, pc.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_cancel (payment_transaction_seq, reason, status) VALUES (#{paymentTransactionSeq}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_cancel AS pc WHERE pc.status = #{status} ORDER BY pc.created_at DESC
